_comment_top: Reference recipe_config.json for openalaqs_standalone. Drop a file named 'recipe_config.json' alongside the .alaqs file with only the keys you want to override; everything else falls through to defaults. Keys starting with '_' are documentation, not parameters, and are ignored.
_alaqs_filename: Optional. Name of the .alaqs file inside the alaqs folder. null = auto-pick if exactly one .alaqs is present. Required only when multiple .alaqs files share a folder.
_year: Inventory year. Determines the full-year hourly time grid (8760 h) when no time window is set.
_include_aircraft: true = fold per-movement aircraft emissions into the same parquet outputs as the stationary sources. false = stationary only.
_pollutants: Comma-separated. Each name maps to an emissions.parquet pollutant column. Recognised: co, hc, nox, sox, pm10, pm25 (co2 is always emitted by the aircraft compute regardless).
_start: ISO timestamp ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]'). null = run the full inventory year. Half-open with --end.
_end: ISO timestamp. Pair with --start. Movements straddling the boundary are clipped per segment.
_comment_section_method: ------- Aircraft emission method + NOx ambient correction -------
_aircraft_method: One of: bymode, bffm2_anchor, bffm2_traj. Only effective when include_aircraft=true. bymode = EEDB mode-anchor EI (bit-identical to QGIS plugin). bffm2_anchor = BFFM2 EI at mode-anchor fuel flow. bffm2_traj = BFFM2 EI with per-segment trajectory fuel flow.
_use_isa_meteo: true = force ISA (288.15 K, 101325 Pa, RH 0.6) for the BFFM2 ambient correction. false = use tbl_InvMeteo (matches QGIS plugin output). Ignored when aircraft_method=bymode and for helicopter movements.
_apply_nox_corrections: true = apply the ICCAIA / CAEP14 v14 NOx ambient correction at TO and CL segments. Reads T/P/RH from tbl_InvMeteo per period; reads airport elevation from user_study_setup; reads tow_ratio per movement from user_aircraft_movements (defaults 1.0). Only effective when aircraft_method=bymode; BFFM2 methods incorporate their own ambient correction and ignore this flag.
_source_dynamics: Smooth-and-shift mode for aircraft spatial apportionment. One of: none, default, sas. none = each segment apportioned by its centreline. default / sas = segments widened to the per-group, per-stage extent from default_emission_dynamics and apportioned by footprint area (sas uses the larger 'smooth & shift' extents). Affects spatial distribution only; movement emission totals are identical across modes.
_meteo_year_shift: Optional integer year offset for the meteo CSV. e.g. CSV is for 2023, target year is 2025 -> set to 2. null = no shift. Only used when an external meteo CSV is supplied via the meteo_folder_in input folder.
_receptor_source_epsg: Source EPSG of the receptor CSV coordinates. e.g. 28992 for Dutch RD. null = treat the receptor CSV as already in the target projection.
_receptor_target_epsg: Target EPSG (the AUSTAL grid's UTM zone). null = auto-pick the study's UTM zone from user_study_setup.
_receptor_name_col: Column in the receptor CSV that carries the receptor name. null = default 'name'.
_receptor_x_col: Column carrying x / longitude / easting. null = default 'longitude'.
_receptor_y_col: Column carrying y / latitude / northing. null = default 'latitude'.
_title: Title written to austal.txt 'ti' line. null = pulled from user_study_setup airport_name / project_name.
_qs: AUSTAL quality level (qs line in austal.txt). 3 = default.
_grid_size: DEPRECATED. Ignored when grid_3d_definition is set in the .alaqs (which is the normal case). Used only as a fallback when the alaqs file has no grid_3d_definition table.
_grid_step: DEPRECATED. Same as grid_size: ignored when the alaqs file has grid_3d_definition.
_processes: Worker processes for the aircraft compute. 1 = serial. >1 uses the multiprocessing driver (bit-identical to serial). Stationary computes are numpy-vectorised and ignore this.
_clear_output_folders: Orchestrator-only. true = empty pre-existing output folders before writing. Honoured by external orchestrators that manage staging; the CLI ignores it.
